items.headline: Special Weather Statement issued October 3 at 2:01AM AKDT by NWS Juneau AK
items.description:
A stronger weather system is expected to move into the panhandle
Saturday into Sunday, bringing periods of moderate to heavy rain.
The peak of heavier rainfall is forecast to occur overnight Saturday
into Sunday, when rain rates could exceed 0.15 inches per hour.

Total rainfall accumulations for the event are expected to be
between 1.5 and 3.0 inches, with the greatest amounts in the central
panhandle. Upwards of 5 inches is possible for higher elevations.

items.headline: Wind Advisory issued October 2 at 12:06PM AKDT until October 4 at 10:00PM AKDT by NWS Anchorage AK
items.description:
* WHAT...West to Southwest winds 30 to 40 mph with gusts up to 50 mph
expected.

* WHERE...Unalaska and Nikolski.

* WHEN...From 4 AM to 10 PM AKDT Sunday.

* IMPACTS...Gusty winds will blow around unsecured objects and a few
power outages may result. Travel may be difficult.
